description: This file contains helper functions for the Mustach templating engine, including error handling, memory file management, file reading, escaping, and stream handling.

methods.name: mustach_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error code.

methods.name: mustach_read_file
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a buffer.

methods.name: mustach_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a buffer and emits them via a callback.

methods.name: mustach_fwrite
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file stream.

methods.name: mustach_fwrite_cb
methods.description: Callback for fwrite to a file stream.

methods.name: mustach_fwrite_escape
methods.description: Writes an escaped version of a buffer to a file stream.

methods.name: mustach_write
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach_write_cb
methods.description: Callback for writing to a file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach_write_escape
methods.description: Writes an escaped buffer to a file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach_stream_abort
methods.description: Aborts a mustach stream and frees resources.

methods.name: mustach_stream_end
methods.description: Finalizes a stream and returns the buffer.

methods.name: mustach_stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to a mustach stream.

methods.name: mustach_stream_write_cb
methods.description: Callback for writing data to a mustach stream.
